algorithm.reason: Canonical bottom-up construction. Every node, including every leaf, is separately allocated with apr_palloc from the existing Apache APR library pool, as in the C reference. All nodes have two child slots and the same 16-byte allocation. Every tree is walked and its temporary pool cleared. Stretch storage is destroyed before long-lived allocation; long-lived nodes remain live through all temporary trees. Algorithm is entirely in Mojo; library only allocates/releases bytes. Flat/indexed-array tree candidates are archived and excluded for omitting per-node allocation.

unsupported.reason: The array representation constructs and traverses all node values, but omits the required per-node heap/library-pool allocations. Futhark 0.27.1 has flattened array values and no recursive heap-reference data model or outgoing C allocator calls. A native tree executor would violate the language-source rule.
